text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Phew……! Thanks for pacing with me, 
Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No sweat, no sweat! Once we're done 
resting, wanna get back to running?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... No! I think I'll wrap it up for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Flight-senpai, you're calling it a 
day already? Man, I really wanted to run 
with you...!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I'm sorry, Biko-chan. Let's run 
together another time, I promise!

North Flight leaves the track. Compared to 
the other Umamusume, it seems like she's 
wrapping up awfully early, but...
choice_data_list:
(Could she be feeling under the 
weather...？)

text_block_list.text:
Unable to stop worrying, I went to check 
on her and found North Flight in the 
library.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
, Air Groove-san! The race tactics book 
you recommended was incredibly helpful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not a problem. If you found it useful, 
that's all that matters. There are a few 
other things I could recommend—would you 
like to hear them?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
! By all means, yes! If possible, I'd love 
to deepen my understanding of the 
characteristics of each course.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall pick out a few 
options.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, your dedication to never 
neglecting your classroom studies... is 
truly admirable.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. —Due to my constitution, I 
can't push myself too hard in training, so 
I have plenty of time on my hands.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to lament what I was 
given. Even with a weak body, there are 
still things I can do.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I can't put in the miles, I'll think 
and think and think. I'll find my own way 
to shine, I promise!

It seems my worries were entirely 
unfounded. North Flight simply understood 
herself perfectly and acted accordingly.
choice_data_list:
(It's amazing how quickly and accurately 
she makes decisions.)

(I should really learn from that 
mindset……)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh…… Indeed. Keep that up, and make sure 
that prized speed of yours shines with 
proper splendor.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... What admirable fortitude of 
mind. However, if growth is what you seek, 
I shall gladly lend my support. All right, 
let us go retrieve the books.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes♪
